name: x_mtts.default_currency
description: Operating currency ISO code for ticket fares. Candidate options: USD, INR, EUR, GBP. Subject to owner approval.

name: x_mtts.max_passengers_per_booking
description: Maximum number of passengers permitted in a single booking transaction. Candidate limit: 6. Subject to owner approval.

name: x_mtts.max_advance_booking_days
description: Maximum allowable days in advance for scheduling a travel date. Candidate window: 30 days. Subject to owner approval.

name: x_mtts.cancellation_tier_greater_24h_pct
description: Illustrative refund percentage for cancellations requested more than 24 hours prior to travel date. Pending policy sign-off.

name: x_mtts.cancellation_tier_2_to_24h_pct
description: Illustrative refund percentage for cancellations requested between 2 and 24 hours prior to travel date. Pending policy sign-off.

name: x_mtts.cancellation_tier_less_2h_pct
description: Illustrative refund percentage for cancellations requested less than 2 hours prior to travel date. Pending policy sign-off.

name: x_mtts.cancellation.policy_status
description: Operational governance gate for booking cancellation and refund calculations. Default UNCONFIGURED blocks cancellation until formal policy approval. Candidate active value: ACTIVE.

name: x_mtts.lifecycle.enable_rejected_status
description: Controls whether the proposed 5th lifecycle status 'Rejected' is enabled. Default false retains the baseline 4-status model (Pending, Approved, Generated, Cancelled) with administrative rejection fallback.

name: x_mtts.scanner.rate_limit_window_sec
description: Rolling time window in seconds for tracking repeated failed ticket verification attempts per scanner/client.

name: x_mtts.scanner.max_failed_attempts
description: Maximum permitted failed verification attempts within the rate-limit window before triggering temporary lockout (HTTP 429).

name: x_mtts.scanner.audit_logging_enabled
description: Flag to enable structured verification logging into x_mtts_scan_event table for all turnstile scans.

name: x_mtts.notifications.enabled
description: Global master switch for event-driven email notifications triggered by booking lifecycle transitions. Default false keeps production outbound email disabled until instance activation.

name: x_mtts.notifications.sender_display_name
description: Outbound sender display name for automated passenger and staff notifications.

name: x_mtts.audit.retention_policy_status
description: Operational governance safety gate for scan event audit data retention. Default UNCONFIGURED blocks automated deletions until formal transit authority approval. Candidate active value: ACTIVE.

name: x_mtts.audit.retention_days
description: Approved retention window in days for x_mtts_scan_event records. Inactive while retention_policy_status is UNCONFIGURED. Candidate value: subject to transit authority sign-off.
